h: Former Head of State Abdulsalami Abubakar loses niece
p: Former Head of State General Abdulsalami Abubakar is mourning the death of his niece, Fatimah Hassana Toto. Information Minister Mohammed Idris visited him in Minna to offer condolences.
body: Former Head of State General Abdulsalami Abubakar is mourning the death of his niece, Fatimah Hassana Toto.

Minister of Information and National Orientation Mohammed Idris travelled to Minna, Niger State, on Saturday, 21 November 2026, to pay his respects. He visited the former military leader at his Hilltop residence and later joined family members and sympathisers at the family home in Angwar Daji, where prayers were offered for the deceased.
Abdulsalami Abubakar led Nigeria between 1998 and 1999 and oversaw the return to civilian rule.
more: His niece was Fatimah Hassana Toto.
The Information Minister visited him in Minna.
Prayers were held at the family home.
